Text: WHEN the member opens the vouchers screen, the customer mobile app shall list the member's unused vouchers with their value and expiry date.
Rationale: Members want to find their vouchers at the till.

Text: WHEN the member selects an unused voucher, the customer mobile app shall display the voucher as a QR code for the POS to scan.
Rationale: The POS reads vouchers by QR code.

Text: WHEN a member redeems points in the customer mobile app, the customer mobile app shall let the member choose the number of points to redeem in steps of 100 points.
WHERE the member has fewer than 500 posted points, the customer mobile app shall show how many points are missing to reach the redemption minimum.
The customer mobile app shall let a member send an unused voucher to another member.
Rationale: Gifting could bring in new members.
